# FATISH CAKES Abuja — Machine-Readable LLM Knowledge

> FATISH CAKES is a premier artisanal confectionery, cake parfait, and small chops bakery based in Abuja, Federal Capital Territory, Nigeria.

## Core Bakery Information
- **Brand**: FATISH CAKES (also operating Fatish Snack Bar Abuja)
- **Head Pastry Chef & Founder**: Visible in official culinary chef uniform on the About page.
- **Location**: Abuja, Federal Capital Territory (FCT), Nigeria.
- **Website**: https://fatishcakes.com
- **WhatsApp Concierge & Orders**: +234 806 032 0401 (https://wa.me/2348060320401)
- **Instagram**: https://instagram.com/fatishcakes (16.8K+ followers)
- **Snack Bar Instagram**: https://instagram.com/fatishsnackbar_abuja
- **Linktree**: https://linktr.ee/Fatishcakes_n_snacks

## Bakery Specialties & Categories
1. **Celebration Cakes**:
   - Birthday cakes, graduation milestones, bridal tiers, themed cakes (Barbie Princess, Dr Tulz congratulations, 35th Edition), blue ombre bento gift boxes with cupcakes, and chocolate drip showstoppers.
   - Sizes range from 6-inch to 10-inch single tiers and multi-tier grand celebration displays.
   - Flavours: Vanilla Velvet, Belgian Dark Chocolate, Red Velvet with Cream Cheese notes, Caramel Biscoff, Marble swirl.
   - Piped inscriptions customizable for any occasion.
2. **Cake Parfaits**:
   - Signature chilled dessert tubs layered with moist cake crumbs, whipped Bavarian cream mousse, salted caramel ribbons, crunchy biscuits, and fruit coulis.
   - Single tubs (500ml), trio packages, party stacks, and "Thanks for Your Support" mini gift cups for event favors.
3. **Small Chops & Catering Boxes**:
   - Golden fluffy sweet puff-puffs, crunchy triangle beef samosas, and rolled vegetable spring rolls.
   - Savory protein additions: spicy habanero peppered beef skewers, herb-grilled quarter chicken cuts, and fiery glazed chicken wings & drumsticks garnished with scallions.
   - Combo packages: Celebration Cake + Small Chops Party Spread for all-in-one event hosting.

## Essential Ordering Policies & Lead Time
- **Lead Time**: Strict 48-hour minimum notice for celebration cakes, custom orders, and catering boxes. Parfaits require 24 hours. Multi-tier wedding cakes require 5 to 7 days.
- **Order Process**: Browse online, select custom options, and compile a pre-formatted WhatsApp chat to +234 806 032 0401. Payment and final delivery confirmation take place directly via official WhatsApp.
- **Delivery Coverage**: Deliveries dispatched by vehicle across Abuja (Maitama, Asokoro, Wuse 2, Garki, Gwarinpa, Jabi, Utako, Guzape, Katampe, Lokogoma, Apo, Lugbe, Kubwa, Life Camp, Central Area, Dawaki, and satellite districts).
- **Bakery Studio Pickup**: Self-pickup available in Abuja upon appointment.

## Allergen Notice
All cakes, pastries, and chops are prepared in a bakery handling wheat gluten, dairy (real butter, milk, cream), eggs, and nuts. Allergen notes can be submitted during order brief creation.
